headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere, 'Heroes' and 'Nashville' Actor, Dies at 36
headlines.description: Police are investigating the sudden death of Hayden Panettiere, star of TV and film, after being found unresponsive at her South Carolina home. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Woman jumps to escape Berlin high-rise fire
headlines.description: Dramatic new video shows a woman jumping from the 11th floor of a high-rise and into a firefighter’s arms, as flames shoot out of an apartment window. NBC News’ Daniele Hamamdjian reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: A McDonald’s provides normalcy in Ukraine and actor Hayden Panettiere dies: Morning Rundown
headlines.description: How a McDonalds in Ukraine became a refuge for residents through Russian bombardments.

headlines.title: Kushner meets with Netanyahu after rare Hamas talks over stalled Gaza plan
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner was set to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday after rare talks with the leader of Hamas, in a new push to revive the peace plan for Gaza that Israel has rejected.

headlines.title: Actor Hayden Panettiere, known for roles in ‘Heroes’ and ‘Nashville,’ dies at 36
headlines.description: The cause and manner of death were unclear. Panettiere revealed this year that she struggled with postpartum depression and addiction, which she said led to her decision to give up custody of her daughter in 2018.

headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Plus, a major-league pitcher whose groundbreaking surgery extended the careers of MLB greats dies at 83.

headlines.title: Woman leaps from 11th-floor ledge into firefighter’s arms as Berlin high-rise burns
headlines.description: As a furious blaze raged inside a high-rise apartment building in Berlin, one woman was rescued by scaling the building’s exterior and taking a terrifying leap more than two stories down to safety.

headlines.title: Former MLB pitcher Tommy John dies at age 83
headlines.description: Tommy John, the longtime Major League baseball pitcher whose name is forever linked to the groundbreaking elbow surgery that saved his career and those of countless others since, has died, officials said Sunday.

headlines.title: This dentist-recommended Philips Sonicare electric toothbrush is under $35 right now
headlines.description: This electric toothbrush comes recommended by dentists and will last up to two weeks on a full charge. It’s on sale on Amazon for $35 right now.
